title: [GAP-1] No way to bring a live group onto a new relay (S5 has no mechanism)
description: Review finding GAP-1: No way to bring a live group onto a new relay (S5 has no mechanism) (lens GAP). Location: ARCHITECTURE.md:106-109; spec/10-relays.md:612-624; spec/05-messaging.md:203; spec/02-identity.md:302; spec/04-access-control.md:151; spec/12-security.md:36. Fix: As proposed. I found no relay-set, migration or history-import text: "migrat" hits only the managed/SaaS DNS paragraph (10-relays:19), and `relayHints` exists only in public SpaceAds (10-relays:284) and ChannelShareAgreement (08-cross-space:103). More evidence: 04-access-control:151 tells senders to use relays "discoverable from the recipient's DID document relay hints", but 02-identity:302 forbids DID documents from naming relays, so DMs also have no relay-discovery path. ARCHITECTURE §9 already contemplates "A Space that publishes its relay list", so a CO-signed relay set fits the architecture. Registering mid-chain is an extension of Q6's "AccessChainRegistration of first-epoch access keys". Its trust matches the per-epoch `billingSig`, but Mark should confirm it because it changes recorded wording. Full text: notes/review/GAP-verified.md and notes/review/GAP.md.
